captions.detailed: A compact camera speedlight flash unit with a matte black finish. It features a bottom shoe mount for camera attachment, a main vertical battery body, a two-axis articulating neck, and a rectangular flash lamp head with a white diffuser panel. The side of the body features a vertical control strip with four individual push buttons, with the top button highlighted in blue. The neck assembly allows the head to swivel horizontally and tilt vertically to aim the flash.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact camera speedlight flash with realistic proportions. Include a bottom hot shoe mount, a vertical main body with a side control strip containing four push buttons (the top one colored blue), a two-axis articulating mount, and a rectangular flash head with a front diffuser panel. Ensure the design supports horizontal swivel and vertical tilt articulations.
captions.factory: Construct the base hot shoe mount using a thin rectangular box. Build the main battery body as a stepped vertical box with chamfered or filleted edges. Add the side control strip as a recessed rectangular strip, populating it with four small prismatic button boxes. Model the neck swivel joint using a cylinder, and the tilt joint using a horizontal cylindrical pivot. Create the rectangular flash head as a hollowed or inset box, adding a thin white rectangular plate on the front face to represent the diffuser panel. Define revolute joint articulations for both the horizontal swivel and vertical tilt axes.
